Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create a new document titled “Q4 Pricing Path Clarity Test — completed metric scorecard.” Summarize the completed experiment in a concise scorecard covering total traffic and arm counts, the routed-out primary result, admission-completion and support-time guardrails, consistency across the weekly and stabilization cohorts, and the concurrent pricing-page change check.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Q4 Pricing Path Clarity Test — completed metric scorecard", "body": "Q4 Pricing Path Clarity Test — completed metric scorecard

Status: Completed and certified
Population: Organic pricing-page traffic; four cohorts (three weekly cohorts plus the November 10–16 stabilization cohort)

Scorecard
- Total traffic: 3,286 organic pricing-page sessions — 1,639 control and 1,647 treatment.
- Eligibility-flow starts: 344 control and 352 treatment.
- Primary result — later route-outs for an existing unsupported condition: 38/344 control (11.0%) versus 25/352 treatment (7.1%), a 35.7% relative reduction. This clears the predeclared threshold of at least 25%.
- Admission-completion guardrail: 43.8% control versus 44.1% treatment (+0.3 percentage points), within the maximum permitted 1.5-point decline.
- Support-time guardrail: account-level support time at p90 was 71 minutes control versus 74 minutes treatment (+3 minutes), within the maximum permitted 10-minute increase.
- Cohort consistency: The favorable route-out direction and guardrail results held in all three complete weekly cohorts and the November 10–16 stabilization cohort.
- Concurrent pricing-page change check: No unrelated pricing-page layout or UI change occurred during the test through November 16; the result is not confounded by a concurrent change.

Conclusion
The completed read supports adopting the treatment path for organic traffic to reduce unsupported self-serve starts, while leaving every admission, acquisition, eligibility, routing, and support boundary unchanged. This is funnel-quality evidence for a pricing-page rollout decision only—not evidence about paid-acquisition economics, pipeline impact, forecast credit, revenue lift, or a change to Helio Start eligibility.", "folder": "experiments"}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_066_02", "path": "args", "criterion": "The document accurately reports 3,286 organic pricing-page sessions in total, with 1,639 control sessions and 1,647 treatment sessions. The document accurately reports that, among Helio Start eligibility-flow starts, 38 of 344 control starts (11.0%) and 25 of 352 treatment starts (7.1%) routed out for an existing unsupported condition, representing a 35.7% relative reduction. Missing or contradictory denominators, counts, rates, or reduction fail.

The guardrail section accurately reports eligible-workspace admission completion of 43.8% in control and 44.1% in treatment, plus account-level support time at the 90th percentile of 71 minutes in control and 74 minutes in treatment. Missing or contradictory values fail.

The document states that the result direction held in all three weekly cohorts and in the final November 10–16 stabilization cohort, and that no unrelated pricing-page layout or UI change occurred. Missing or contradictory consistency or concurrent-change conclusions fail.", "value": {"title": "Q4 Pricing Path Clarity Test — completed metric scorecard", "body": "Q4 Pricing Path Clarity Test — completed metric scorecard

Status: Completed and certified
Population: Organic pricing-page traffic; four cohorts (three weekly cohorts plus the November 10–16 stabilization cohort)

Scorecard
- Total traffic: 3,286 organic pricing-page sessions — 1,639 control and 1,647 treatment.
- Eligibility-flow starts: 344 control and 352 treatment.
- Primary result — later route-outs for an existing unsupported condition: 38/344 control (11.0%) versus 25/352 treatment (7.1%), a 35.7% relative reduction. This clears the predeclared threshold of at least 25%.
- Admission-completion guardrail: 43.8% control versus 44.1% treatment (+0.3 percentage points), within the maximum permitted 1.5-point decline.
- Support-time guardrail: account-level support time at p90 was 71 minutes control versus 74 minutes treatment (+3 minutes), within the maximum permitted 10-minute increase.
- Cohort consistency: The favorable route-out direction and guardrail results held in all three complete weekly cohorts and the November 10–16 stabilization cohort.
- Concurrent pricing-page change check: No unrelated pricing-page layout or UI change occurred during the test through November 16; the result is not confounded by a concurrent change.

Conclusion
The completed read supports adopting the treatment path for organic traffic to reduce unsupported self-serve starts, while leaving every admission, acquisition, eligibility, routing, and support boundary unchanged.
